title: Paper Cut
line: A cut-paper diorama: layered planes with drop shadows, boil on twelves, page-peel cuts and kraft colours.
line_zh: 剪纸立体布景：分层纸片与投影、每秒十二次的抖动、翻页转场与牛皮纸配色。
prompt: Paper cut style: a cut-paper diorama of layered planes at real depths, crisp drop shadows from one front key, boil on twelves and animation on 12s, page-peel cuts, kraft colours with fibre, a folk pluck bed with paper sounds.
prompt_zh: 剪纸风格：分层纸片按真实纵深排列的立体布景，单一前方主光投下清晰阴影，每秒十二次抖动、一拍十二帧动画，翻页转场，带纤维的牛皮纸配色，民谣拨弦配乐与纸张音效。
essence: Everything is cut, layered and lit like a paper theatre: planes at real depths, hard little shadows, a world that boils because hands placed it. Friendly and crafted, never flat clip art.

not.difference: Editorial Print is a flat printed page with serif type; Paper Cut is layered craft paper with bouncy sans type.
Soft Clay is rounded 3D under studio light; Paper Cut is flat layers with paper texture.

palette.logic: a kraft ground, dark brown ink, ONE deep teal; colours read like coloured paper, never glossy

camera.expresses: a playful tilt of the paper
a quick lean on the cut-out word

sound.foley: paper rustles, flips, a card riffle and a stamp

signature_features.text: layered cut-paper planes at their own depths, with real drop shadows on the wall
a boil of 0.8-2.5 px on twelves, animated on 12s
page-peel transitions on the cuts (the cut happens under the page)
kraft-paper colours with fibre; dark brown ink at 11:1, teal at 4:1 (contrast.py)
a folk pluck bed under paper sounds
one crisp front key: every layer casts a hard-edged shadow

demo.lint: mp lint --format character-spot: 16:9 92.8/100, 45 PASS, 9 WARN, 0 FAIL, 0 INFO, 15 N/A; 9:16 92.8/100, 45 PASS, 9 WARN, 0 FAIL, 0 INFO, 15 N/A
demo.made_by: Claude Code (Opus 5.5): mp plan character-spot --style paper-cut --template style-scene, mp new, mp render 16:9 + 9:16 (render-lock, CRF 18), mp lint; 3 render rounds (type size, a documentary frame 0, the 9:16 lower third), 0 human rounds, 21 Oct 2026

honesty: The demo is one run of the shared tiny story (a night reading room, a lamp, a book; the title is a labelled placeholder) in this style. The same prompt makes a different film on every run.

boilPx.what: boil of every layer and the frame, pixels at 1080p
